steps.label: the-nam-engine-attaches
steps.script: (async()=>{const m=await import('/static/nam/index.js');const ctx=new AudioContext();const eng=await m.NamEngine.attach(ctx,{assetBaseUrl:'/static/nam/'});const n=await eng.createNode();const ok=(n instanceof AudioWorkletNode);await n.dispose();await ctx.close();return ok})()

steps.label: an-amp-model-loads-and-stays-in-the-chain
steps.script: (async()=>{const amps=await (await fetch('/api/amps')).json();const model=amps.find(a=>a.kind==='model');if(!model)return 'no models installed';document.getElementById('gt-amp-btn').click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800));const b=document.getElementById('amp-picker');const btn=[...b.querySelectorAll('[data-model]')].find(x=>x.dataset.model===model.file);btn.click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,6000));return Mixer.guitar.state.ampName===model.name})()

steps.label: a-cabinet-loads-too
steps.script: (async()=>{const amps=await (await fetch('/api/amps')).json();const ir=amps.find(a=>a.kind==='ir');if(!ir)return 'no irs installed';document.getElementById('gt-amp-btn').click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800));const b=document.getElementById('amp-picker');const btn=[...b.querySelectorAll('[data-ir]')].find(x=>x.dataset.ir===ir.file);btn.click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,3000));return Mixer.guitar.state.cabName===ir.name})()

steps.label: recording-becomes-a-track-on-disk
steps.script: (async()=>{Mixer.guitar.startRecording();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2200));const stem=await Mixer.guitar.stopRecording();if(!stem)return 'nothing saved';await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,3000));const list=await (await fetch('/api/stems')).json();const song=list.find(s=>s.name==='Calin - Stovky let');return song.stems.includes(stem)})()

steps.label: cleanup
steps.script: (async()=>{await Mixer.guitar.stop();const list=await (await fetch('/api/stems')).json();const song=list.find(s=>s.name==='Calin - Stovky let');for(const t of song.stems.filter(x=>x.startsWith('take-'))){await fetch('/api/stems/Calin%20-%20Stovky%20let/record/'+t,{method:'DELETE'});}await fetch('/api/stems/Calin%20-%20Stovky%20let/session',{method:'DELETE'});return true})()
